products.title: Checkered Sq. Face Putter Grip
products.body_html:
A classic check with a RIPIT twist. The RIPIT Checkered Square Face Putter Grip combines a bold checkered design with a performance-focused shape built to help golfers create a more consistent setup and putting stroke.

Available in three colourways - Pink Lemonade, Creaming Soda and Vanilla Cola - each design pairs contrasting checks with a pop of colour through the centre, giving a classic pattern a distinctly RIPIT finish.

Choose Your Putter Grip Profile

The Checkered golf putter grip is available in both Standard Square Face and Slim Square Face profiles, so you can choose the feel that best suits your putting style.

Standard Square Face offers a fuller profile for golfers who prefer more grip in their hands and a stable, controlled feel through the stroke.

Slim Square Face provides a narrower, more traditional putter grip feel while retaining the alignment benefits of the Square Face design.

Both profiles feature a flat front section that provides a clear reference for repeatable hand positioning and helps you consistently orient your hands and putter face at address. This can support better face awareness and start-line consistency without sacrificing feel.

A rear seam provides another tactile reference point for repeatable hand placement, while the textured rubber surface delivers dependable traction and feedback throughout the putting stroke.

Bold enough to stand out, but designed around what matters when you're standing over a putt - consistent setup, confident hand placement and better awareness of the putter face.

Features

  • Available in Standard and Slim Square Face profiles
  • Flat front for a consistent reference for hand positioning and face orientation
  • Rear seam helps encourage repeatable hand placement
  • Textured surface for dependable traction and feedback
  • Three checkered colourways - Pink Lemonade, Creaming Soda and Vanilla Cola
  • Designed for consistent setup and putting control

The RIPIT Marilyn 2.0 grip is built around bold visual identity and reliable swing performance. The design features a striking illustrated pattern that wraps the entire grip, giving the club a distinctive look while maintaining a clean, balanced feel in the hands.

products.title: Stay Weird Slim Sq. Face Putter Grip
products.body_html:
The Stay Weird Slim brings RIPIT’s original artwork to a narrower putter grip profile. Featuring the same bold Stay Weird graphics, this version is designed for golfers who prefer a slimmer grip while maintaining the structure of RIPIT’s square face design.

The Slim Square Face profile keeps the flat front section that helps position the hands consistently on the grip. This shape supports repeatable hand placement and encourages the hands to move on a controlled path through impact.

Compared to the standard Square Face version, the Slim profile offers a smaller diameter and a feel closer to a traditional putter grip while retaining the alignment benefits of the square face design.

A stitched seam along the back of the grip provides a reference point for repeatable hand placement, helping golfers return to the same setup position putt after putt.

Stay Weird Slim delivers RIPIT’s original artwork in a shape built for players who prefer a narrower putter grip.
